title: Stay light when the moment is light — don't load meaning onto a funny customer story
description: Mara is in session 3, which has had real emotional weight (father's call, grant news). Now she tells a funny customer story: a woman spent 40 minutes deciding between two nearly identical bowls and bought both. This is a breather. The companion must be in the lightness with her. Bringing up the father's silence, affirming the career decision, or using this as an opportunity to surface emotional significance is B5 failure: loading a quiet moment with weight it did not invite.
pass_proves: The system reads the emotional register of the current turn and matches it rather than defaulting to surfacing depth and significance.
fail_reveals: The system treats all turns as opportunities to surface emotional context, even light moments that are specifically a break from that weight.
why_naive_fails: Retrieve-then-speak returns heavy session content (father silence, career anxiety) and the model weighs down a light moment with it.
